0022600110.text: The Denver Nuggets (0-1, 11th in the West and 5th in the Northwest, 1.5 games back) host the New Orleans Pelicans (0-2, 10th in the West and 4th in the Southwest, 1.5 games back), with both clubs still seeking their first win of the season. Denver is missing Cameron Johnson (ankle sprain), Julian Strawther (knee sprain) and Spencer Jones (hamstring), and Alpha Diallo (wrist) is day-to-day and a game-time decision, while New Orleans has Yves Missi (knee) listed as day-to-day and a game-time decision. Denver won all three meetings in the 2025-26 season, including a 122-116 win in New Orleans on January 13, 2026, and no games have been played yet in the 2026-27 season series.
